outcome.Summary: Fixed six bugs in ini/ini.go's Parse against the documented format: (1) trim each line before checking for empty/comments, and treat both ';' and '#' as comment markers; (2) lower-case section names; (3) split key/value on the first '=' (was LastIndex, breaking values containing '='); (4) for quoted values, strip the quotes without trimming the inner whitespace (was TrimSpace'd, losing "  a  " spacing); (5) strip inline comments only at ' ;' or ' #' in unquoted values, re-checking for quotes after truncation, so quoted values keep their ';'/'#' content; (6) repeated keys in a section now overwrite the earlier value. Verified with go test ./... (passes) plus a temporary ad-hoc test exercising the documented-but-untested cases, which I then removed.
